stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The team followed a waterfall process from design to testing.
items.sentenceZh: 团队按瀑布式流程，从设计一步步推进到测试。
items.scene: A clean software project diagram built from four large descending terraces: requirements sketches flow into a design blueprint, then a built app module, then a tested completed module. A single one-way stream and gated handoffs make the sequential waterfall development model clear, not a natural waterfall. No people, readable writing, code, labels or numbers.
items.altText: 软件项目沿四个逐级下降的阶段，从需求、设计、构建推进到测试。

items.sentenceEn: Finishing the prototype was an important milestone for the project.
items.sentenceZh: 完成原型是这个项目的重要里程碑。
items.scene: A team follows a long curved project path, reaching a distinctive illuminated marker where a finished prototype model stands; the path continues toward later work. Show this completed checkpoint as an important point in a larger journey, rather than a finish line. Mature fully illustrated adult faces, natural hands, no signs, words or numbers.
items.altText: 团队完成原型，站在漫长项目路径上的一个重要节点。

items.sentenceEn: She warmed a pot of soup on the stove.
items.sentenceZh: 她在炉灶上把一锅汤热了热。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese home kitchen, an adult woman gently heats a covered pot of soup on a clearly visible safe kitchen stove; the burner and pot are central, with a small controlled blue flame beneath. Her face and hands are naturally drawn, with no child near the heat, no spill, text or brand.
items.altText: 中国家庭厨房里，女子在炉灶上加热一锅汤。

items.sentenceEn: She gave her consent before the photo was taken.
items.sentenceZh: 她同意后，摄影师才拍下照片。
items.scene: An adult photographer visibly waits with the camera lowered while another adult reviews a simple blank photo preview and gives a clear voluntary approving gesture; only after this approval does a small directional sequence indicate the photograph being taken. Equal respectful posture, natural expressive faces and hands. No coercion, medical setting, forms, text or logos.
items.altText: 摄影师放下相机等待，对方明确同意后才开始拍照。

items.sentenceEn: The roadmap shows which features the team plans to build next.
items.sentenceZh: 路线图展示了团队接下来计划开发哪些功能。
items.scene: A product-planning roadmap as an abstract winding route from a current app block toward three future feature blocks at successive checkpoints; only the first section is complete and later checkpoints remain pale prospective shapes. Small blank task tiles align to the route. No literal highway, cars, readable text, calendar dates, labels or numbers.
items.altText: 产品规划路线从当前版本通向依次安排的未来功能节点。

items.sentenceEn: The team selected two tasks from the backlog for this week.
items.sentenceZh: 团队从待办清单中选了两项任务安排在本周。
items.scene: A tall but orderly stack of many blank colored task cards sits in a backlog tray; exactly two cards are pulled out into a small active-work area beside a compact week-shaped calendar with blank cells. The remaining work visibly waits. No paper with writing, unreadable scribbles, labels, digits, people or logos.
items.altText: 大量任务卡仍留在待办区，只有两张被移到本周工作区。

items.sentenceEn: The kit comprises three tools and a small case.
items.sentenceZh: 这套工具包含三件工具和一个小盒子。
items.scene: An open compact tool kit clearly contains exactly three different hand tools neatly nested in a small fitted case; a soft enclosing outline makes the whole-versus-parts relationship unmistakable. No people, text, labels, numbers or extra tools.
items.altText: 一个小工具盒里整齐装着三件不同工具。

items.sentenceEn: The manager sent a memo about the new meeting time.
items.sentenceZh: 经理发出一份备忘通知，告知大家新的会议时间。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese office, an adult manager distributes the same one-page blank internal memo to several colleagues at their desks; a small blank clock icon and meeting-table icon are printed as shapes on the sheet, but absolutely no letters or pseudo-writing. The shared internal notice is the central object. Fully illustrated faces and natural hands, no brands or logos.
items.altText: 中国办公室里，经理把一份会议时间调整备忘录发给同事。

items.sentenceEn: The calendar reminder helped him remember the appointment.
items.sentenceZh: 日历提醒让他记起了预约。
items.scene: An adult sees a simple bell-shaped notification emerge from a blank calendar square on a phone, then looks toward a prepared appointment bag and coat; the visual relationship conveys a timely reminder bringing a planned event back to mind. Full natural face and hands, no written calendar entries, numbers, brands or text.
items.altText: 手机日历弹出提醒后，男子记起预约并拿起准备好的包。

items.sentenceEn: The two leaves looked alike in shape and color.
items.sentenceZh: 这两片叶子的形状和颜色很相似。
items.scene: Two real leaves from the same species lie side by side, nearly matching in silhouette, veins and green color, with only tiny natural differences; a third obviously different leaf sits farther back to strengthen the comparison. No people, labels, text, symbols or numbers.
items.altText: 并排的两片绿叶在形状、叶脉和颜色上十分相似。

items.sentenceEn: Please notify the team when the package arrives.
items.sentenceZh: 包裹到达时，请通知团队。
items.scene: A parcel arrives at an office reception desk; the receptionist immediately sends a single clear alert icon from a device to a small group of teammates, whose devices light up. The cause and message delivery are both visible. Fully drawn natural adult faces and hands, no writing on parcel, readable interfaces, logos or text.
items.altText: 包裹抵达后，前台向团队成员发送到件通知。

items.sentenceEn: The auditor will audit the records against the stored goods.
items.sentenceZh: 审计人员将把记录和仓库存货逐一核对。
items.scene: An adult auditor in a warehouse systematically compares blank pictorial inventory record cards with visible rows of stored boxes; matching shapes align while one discrepancy is marked only by a colored circle. Emphasize independent verification, not accusation. Natural hands and fully illustrated face; no numbers, readable writing, financial logos or text.
items.altText: 审计人员在仓库把存货与图示记录逐一核对。

items.sentenceEn: The careful placement of the lamp brightened the reading corner.
items.sentenceZh: 台灯摆放得当，让阅读角更明亮。
items.scene: An adult intentionally positions a movable lamp beside a reading chair so a clear cone of light falls precisely onto an open blank book, contrasted with the dimmer area where the lamp had been before. The act of choosing its location is focal. Fully illustrated face, natural hands, no writing, electrical hazard or logos.
items.altText: 台灯被移到阅读椅旁，灯光恰好照亮书页。

items.sentenceEn: One student was absent from the class today.
items.sentenceZh: 今天有一名学生没有来上课。
items.scene: A small adult learning class has several occupied seats and exactly one conspicuously empty chair with an untouched notebook; the instructor glances kindly at that place. Show absence through the missing person rather than a ghostly outline or punishment. Fully drawn faces, natural hands, no names, roll sheet, text or numbers.
items.altText: 课堂里其他座位有人，只有一个座位空着，表示一名学生缺席。

items.sentenceEn: She kneaded the dough before making steamed buns.
items.sentenceZh: 做馒头前，她先揉好面团。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese family kitchen, an adult baker kneads a soft elastic mound of pale dough on a clean flour-dusted board; a bamboo steamer sits nearby as context but the raw dough is the clear focus. Natural hands with believable fingers and fully illustrated face, no writing, branding or text.
items.altText: 中国家庭厨房里，女子在案板上揉一团准备做馒头的面团。

items.meaningZh: 负责任的；有解释义务的
items.sentenceEn: The project lead is accountable for the final result.
items.sentenceZh: 项目负责人需要对最终结果负责。
items.scene: A project lead stands beside a completed but imperfect product prototype, openly showing it to teammates and taking ownership by pointing to a flaw and a concrete repair plan represented by two blank visual tiles. Teammates listen; no blame, hiding or shame. Complete expressive adult faces, natural hands, no readable text, labels or logos.
items.altText: 项目负责人向团队展示成果中的问题，并承担改进责任。

items.sentenceEn: The grandmother taught her grandchild to plant seeds.
items.sentenceZh: 奶奶教孙辈播种。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese family courtyard, an older grandmother gently guides her school-age grandchild in placing seeds into a small garden bed; a framed three-generation family portrait in the background subtly confirms the relationship. Respectful natural faces and hands, safe gardening, no text, stereotypes or logos.
items.altText: 中国家庭庭院里，奶奶教孙辈在小菜畦中播种。

items.sentenceEn: The coordinator allocated supplies to three repair teams.
items.sentenceZh: 协调员把物资分配给三个维修小组。
items.scene: At a workshop table, one coordinator divides a finite pile of identical repair supply kits into three separate trays for three small teams according to visually different needs; all kits end up assigned, making deliberate allocation clear. Diverse fully illustrated adult faces and natural hands, no unfairness implication, labels, writing, digits or logos.
items.altText: 协调员根据需要，把有限维修物资分给三个小组。

items.sentenceEn: The dam holds back the river to form a reservoir.
items.sentenceZh: 水坝拦住河水，形成了一座水库。
items.scene: A wide landscape in a Chinese mountain valley shows a solid engineered dam spanning a river, calm deep reservoir water visibly higher upstream and a narrower controlled downstream flow; clear cross-valley structure and cause-effect. No flood disaster, people at risk, national flags, readable signs, text or logos.
items.altText: 中国山谷里的水坝拦住上游河水，形成水库并控制下游水流。

items.sentenceEn: The applicant submitted her portfolio for the design job.
items.sentenceZh: 这位求职者提交了作品集，申请设计岗位。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese design studio reception desk, an adult job applicant confidently hands over an unmarked portfolio folder containing visual design samples to a hiring representative; a nearby waiting chair and office workspace establish that she is applying, not already employed. Both adults have natural complete faces and hands; no readable résumé, text, brand or logo.
items.altText: 中国设计工作室里，求职者向招聘人员递交作品集。
